messages:
mira: quick shoutout to eli and sam for rescuing the demo laptop circus this morning :sparkles:
eli: haha that was wild — cracked screen, mysterious Bluetooth keyboard pairing, and an HDMI drama. team fix: swapped dongle + reboot dance.
sam: also cleaned up the slides and removed the accidentally embedded 200MB video. PR: https://git.internal/r/slide-cleanup-901
toni: legends. adding a tiny note in the meeting notes so future presenters know the dongle trick.
mira: who wants to nominate eli + sam for a mini-merci on the kudos board? they saved 3 customer minutes.
people-ops: nominated! added "Mini Merci" badge + a $15 coffee voucher each :coffee:
ops-bot: FYI: office gelato delivery tomorrow at 2pm — Headquarters kitchen.
eli: gelato > everything. thank you!
sam: also requesting the coveted sticker: "Presentation Firefighter" — who votes yes?
toni: yes +1, would buy that sticker.
mira: putting an order note in design backlog, cc @design.
people-ops: we can do a tiny enamel pin too if there's enough interest.
eli: made my day, thanks team :heart_eyes:
mira: small victory and a big thanks — you both rock.
people-ops: closing note: added a short how-to to the AV runbook so this is less heroic next time.
